meta-description: Black stains are chemistry — pet urine or water and iron reacting with tannins. When they sand out, when bleach works, and when boards need replacing.
post-summary: November 13, 2026 · Black stains on hardwood are chemistry — pet urine, or water and iron reacting with the wood’s tannins — and whether they sand out is a question of depth. When a refinish clears them, what oxalic acid can and can’t do, and when the honest answer is a dark stain or new boards.
